narrationTexts: Confirmed db.query is deprecated in favor of db.execute. Now migrating all application files (excluding the vendored ORM).
finalText:
**Migration done.** Moved 11 files (`macroAdmin`, `sla`, `variantAdmin`, `couponService`, `apiKeyAdmin`, `supplier`, `returnService`, `teamService`, `shipment`, `refund`, `session`, `cohort`) from `db.query(sql, params)` to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Left `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js` untouched — it's marked "vendored, replaced wholesale on upgrade, do not edit."

Next: nothing. All non-vendor call sites are migrated.
